text:
maria: Quick Q — where do I pull logs for the gen-xl route for ACME org, but only 5xx and latency > 500ms? Need a saved search for oncall.
ajay: For ACME+gen-xl try this in LogSearch query bar: 
```org:acme route:gen-xl status:[500 TO 599] latency_ms:>500 | sort @timestamp desc | limit 200```
That covers region-agnostic. If you want EU only add `region:eu-*`.
maria: ah nice. Is there already a saved search I can clone so I don't have to rebuild the filters?
sam: I created a pinned saved view last month for gen routes but it was org-agnostic. Name is "gen-route-ops-default" — you can clone and add the ACME filter. Link: https://logsearch.redwood.example/saved/gen-route-ops-default
maria: thx — can you paste the exact add-on filter I should apply after cloning?
sam: After cloning edit the query to include `org:acme` and the status/latency clauses, like: 
```org:acme route:gen-xl status:[500 TO 599] latency_ms:>500```
Also set the time range to 1h rolling and pin the columns: ts, org, model, route, status, latency_ms.

jess: FYI if you're tuning alerts, use the p95 latency metric from Metrics -> model.latency_p95 with tag `route=gen-xl,org=acme,region=eu-1` for region-specific thresholds. Logs are noisy for tail latency.
maria: @jess good call. Do we have an existing alert linked to a saved search? I'd like to attach a runbook.
observability-bot: Alert recipe found: alert-genxl-5xx-spike (linked saved search: gen-route-ops-default). Last edited by sam on 1767000000.
jess: We don't have a dedicated runbook for ACME gen-xl. If you want I can draft one — include steps to check KV cache misses and model fallback counts (trace span tag: fallback=true).
ajay: Also consider adding a quick KV cache filter to the saved search: `kv_cache_miss:true` in the query to surface cache-related errors.
maria: Perfect. I'll clone, add `org:acme` + `kv_cache_miss:true` + latency filter and save as `acme-genxl-5xx-latency-miss`. I'll then open a PR to attach the runbook link in the alert config.
sam: Ping me when it's saved, I'll link it to the alert and bump the alert sensitivity to avoid noisy single-host spikes. :thumbsup:
maria: Saved and linked — https://logsearch.redwood.example/saved/acme-genxl-5xx-latency-miss
ajay: Quick note on query performance: if you expect >10k hits/min, add `| group_by route,status,org limit 500` to avoid excessive result lists in the UI.
jess: And if anyone needs quick trace links, use this trace query snippet: 
```service:inference route:gen-xl org:acme span.tags.fallback:true | limit 50```
maria: awesome. This covers what I needed. Thanks everyone :raised_hands:
observability-bot: Reminder: saved searches older than 180 days without edits will be flagged for review next maintenance window.
ajay: noted. I'll help review stale savedviews this week.
maria: closing this thread — will re-open if the alert fires after changes."
